reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 19. Nay or No: 20. Not Voting: 1. Of 39 Yea or Nay votes where the Democratic majority could be computed, 38 (97%) matched that majority (majority = the side most of that party's members voting Yea or Nay took; on average 207 members of that party voted Yea or Nay per roll call).

stands_for.majority_rule: Party majority = the Yea/Nay side taken by most members of that party who voted Yea or Nay on that roll call, counted from the party code in the roll-call XML (all members, including ones no longer serving). Ties have no majority.

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

posts.text:
BREAKING: ICE finally released this 8 year-old boy who was detained and taken from his uncle in San Diego. I'm so relieved that tonight, the boy is back home with his family.

Thank you to everyone who raised your voices and pressured DHS to bring him home — it mattered. https://t.co/Yk8dDoTFmD

Rent prices are continuing to rise across southern California (and nationwide). We can’t afford incremental policy changes. We need bold, transformative solutions that give renters relief and rapidly scale up building.
https://t.co/DMxAXfHpcd

Young people are demanding change. We need to listen to them.

For almost their entire lives, Gen Z has watched their government fail them over and over again. If we want to win back their trust and restore hope, Democrats must deliver this time.
https://t.co/hkOhl3aNEv

It was great to visit Patrick Henry High School to meet these students and answer their questions about Congress and politics. I also met Dr. Cecil Nedelec and her French class to talk about my work in international affairs! https://t.co/cdTvbftBdM

San Ysidro Health is a non-profit that provides health care across San Diego County, including at this clinic in El Cajon. Patients here, like so many nationwide, are paying the price for the Big Ugly Bill. We need to reinvest in health care and ensure everyone can access and afford it.

I visited the USC Alzheimer’s Therapeutic Research Institute here in San Diego to learn about their cutting edge research focused on early detection, prevention, and treatment for Alzheimer’s disease. We need to restore federal funding for critical medical research like this. https://t.co/l3PcWAKAzk

Under Trump, the Department of Homeland Security has repeatedly broken the law and violated court orders that were supposed to protect vulnerable people from being deported to countries where they faced persecution. We must hold them accountable for this.
https://t.co/9wB7F24OmH

Americans resoundingly rejected Trump’s cruel mass deportation policies on Election Day. Stephen Miller and Trump may try to continue weaponizing ICE, but a reckoning is coming. Democrats in Congress WILL use our power to hold them accountable.
https://t.co/LxLsPKNA2J

It was my honor to join The Center to induct 4 new San Diegans to their LGBT Veterans Wall of Honor. Thank you for your courage, sacrifice, and unwavering service to our country, even in the face of hatred and injustice. https://t.co/ft9rT57nXy

Thank you to every U.S. veteran for your service and countless sacrifices. I’m so proud to represent San Diego, one of the largest veteran communities in the country and I’ll keep fighting in Congress to make sure we deliver the resources and support our veterans deserve.

Republicans just voted to protect Secretary Hegseth from impeachment and rubber stamp his illegal actions, including the Iran war that's killed more than 20 service members, injured over 800, and cost us billions.

This isn’t over. Pete Hegseth is unfit, dangerous and must be https://t.co/y3iAqsXNAH

I’m working with the San Diego congressional delegation and our CA Senators to demand answers from DHS about the 8 year-old boy who was taken into federal custody at an ICE check-in last week.

We must keep fighting to ensure his safety and bring him home. https://t.co/qsM2mothZA

To be clear, these cuts are not even part of the devastating cuts to food assistance from the Big Ugly Bill that Republicans passed last year. The Trump Administration is voluntarily proposing to let millions more Americans go hungry – just because. How evil.

Secretary Pete Hegseth has repeatedly broken the law and put our service members in impossible and dangerous positions. And now, he’s blatantly trying to use them as a shield to protect himself from getting impeached by the House — which will happen. His time is up. https://t.co/bebKlKlgmt

I will vote YES to impeach Secretary Pete Hegseth. His rap sheet includes the illegal Iran war, illegal strikes in Yemen (where he mishandled classified information via Signal), and over 200 murders in boat strikes in the Caribbean and Pacific. He’s dangerous and needs to go. https://t.co/sRBUaJLSRQ

This is outrageous and unacceptable. No child should have to endure the trauma of being separated from their family and detained by ICE.

I’m working with the San Diego Congressional delegation to demand answers and bring this 8-year old boy home.
https://t.co/JANB6hJV5Q
Happy Diwali to everyone celebrating in San Diego and across the country! May this holiday bring you hope and remind us that light always triumphs over darkness.

I’m fighting to block a proposed 400-megawatt data center from being built on federal land at NAVWAR, here in San Diego. If built, this would be the largest data center in the state. Our community has been clear: we don’t want this!
https://t.co/kaj8uiBv5M

San Diego does NOT want a massive, unregulated data center in our backyard that skyrockets our utility bills, consumes excessive water, and strains our power grid. That’s why I’m fighting in Congress to STOP this data center from being built at NAVWAR.
https://t.co/eDkTwkOPpv

Trump has now spent $47 BILLION on his reckless war with Iran. The American people don’t want this.

We should be funding child care, health care, food assistance, education – the list goes on. Instead, Trump is funneling money into the war machine.
https://t.co/MI728wvAcU

I’m so grateful to the people of CA-51 for putting your trust in me again and sending me back to Congress for a 4th term.

I’m ready to get back to work – and I’m SO excited to do it with a big Democratic majority in the House AND the Senate!! It's time to DELIVER.

President Trump claims the Iran war will end whenever he wants it to – so why isn’t it over yet?

Americans are paying more for gas (and just about everything else) every single day this war drags on. We need an immediate, diplomatic solution.
https://t.co/MI728ww82s

I’m leading my San Diego colleagues to STOP a massive, unregulated data center from being built at NAVWAR. Our community doesn’t want this and our local leaders are united in opposition.
https://t.co/RDK79mzxFy

🗳️ELECTION DAY RESOURCES:

Find your polling place - https://t.co/m28Ab9rc5W

Track your ballot - https://t.co/IR3GMgYBgp

Same Day Voter Registration - https://t.co/ahyCNieK0G

Need assistance? Call the CA voter hotline: (800) 345-VOTE (8683)

TOMORROW is Election Day! If you haven’t voted yet, you have until 8pm PT on NOV. 3 to drop your ballot off in an official drop box or a vote center near you – or, head to your polling place to vote in person!

San Diego, here’s all the info you need: https://t.co/M1gNwh8DxW

Trump’s EPA has given free passes to over 200 facilities spewing cancer-causing chemicals and pollution into communities nationwide. Trump doesn’t care about protecting your health; he just wants to make his billionaire donors and friends happy.
https://t.co/SMSupjlEQ4

Abortion bans don’t just strip women of bodily autonomy; they can also dangerously undermine the entire medical system, like we’re seeing in Idaho. 4 years into a near-total abortion ban, there aren’t enough doctors to perform routine but life-saving care.
https://t.co/hv8pT6lgdT

If Congress does nothing, the rise of AI could create the biggest wealth transfer in history from the bottom to the top. That’s why I’ve introduced bills, like the Tax and Work Protection Act and the AI-Related Job Impacts Clarity Act to protect workers.
https://t.co/UqggiIB6N1

ProPublica found that under Trump, over 170 U.S. citizens have been brutalized, arrested, and detained – sometimes with no charges and without access to an attorney – by ICE and Border Patrol. They're not enforcing the law; they're violating it.
https://t.co/EyFhG5UkWy

Trump's crackdown on legal immigration has an exception: his political allies like right wing authoritarian Flávio Bolsonaro and his family. Meanwhile, he has no problem cutting off TPS for over a dozen countries.
https://t.co/MUoe2K8zC4

The scariest part of Halloween this year might be the costs. If you’re spooked by the price of candy or your online costume order – you should know it’s because of Trump’s tariffs and the high cost of fuel due to his war in Iran.
https://t.co/bqMNdDmlj9

Dolores Huerta was a fearless labor leader, feminist, and civil rights champion. She built a movement that changed the lives of countless working people. May her legacy continue to inspire us all to fight for justice and dignity for everyone. Rest in power. https://t.co/cUgpL1HtZk

posts.text:
Trump's Justice Department, with the help of Republicans in Congress, is hiding evidence of the President's crimes and ties to Epstein. When Democrats are back in charge, we'll use our power to launch real investigations of this corrupt Administration.
https://t.co/ISFfUYHjSl

I’m devastated – this is the first known death at Otay Mesa under Trump 2.0. Their family still hasn’t been notified yet, and they deserve answers and accountability. ICE and CoreCivic must fully cooperate with the investigation and release their findings publicly.  
https://t.co/l08tNE6iMk

Donald Trump is bragging about Big Oil and Gas profiting off his Iran war because it's making HIM rich through stocks. But every other American family has paid over $850 more on average for gas since the start of this war. 
https://t.co/01uyzDDyuP

The public has a right to real information about our government (not propaganda), and Trump’s repeated efforts to ban the free press violates it. I’ve introduced legislation to protect press access at the Pentagon and I’m glad to see this being fought in the courts. https://t.co/tpfmE8tk76

Our service members and their families have already sacrificed so much with no clear end goal. Fuel prices are out of control. And, Congress never authorized this war. Trump needs to end his war with Iran now.
https://t.co/jQYHKKz025

Who’s WE?? Donald Trump may be cashing in with his millions in oil and gas stocks, but his reckless war with Iran has COST regular Americans a fortune at the pump. But like he said himself, Trump doesn’t give a damn. https://t.co/DIXPDRguoL

Yesterday, we witnessed the people of Serbia and Brazil reject corrupt, violent authoritarianism and embrace democracy.

Broad-based, pro-democracy movements – just like the one we’ve been building here in the U.S. – have the power to topple regimes. There is hope.

Here’s how this works: big corporations and billionaires are “donating” tens of millions of dollars to Trump’s White House ballroom project as a way to buy his favor – and Trump is more than happy to oblige. The whole thing is a corrupt, dirty scheme. It needs to end.
https://t.co/QJKaEtxUg1

I met with these local leaders with Team ENOUGH, Brady United’s youth-led initiative focused on educating and mobilizing young people to stop gun violence. We must end the gun violence epidemic and protect future generations from this unnecessary trauma. https://t.co/1FmYXQTIJv

Every day the Trump Administration shows us who they really are: the villains. This is so inhumane, cruel, and twisted.

And the only thing Republicans in Congress have done is give blank checks to DHS and the Pentagon to support this shit.
https://t.co/UDuvAsp8FU

I was so happy to meet these 5th, 6th, and 7th graders in the Rise Up Leadership Academy and answer their questions about Congress! This program supports at-risk youth to help them thrive in school and become leaders in their community while avoiding gang involvement. https://t.co/z88d2pZRp4

Our Spring 2027 internship applications are now open for both my Washington D.C. and San Diego offices! This is a paid opportunity for college students and recent graduates. Applications are due October 29, 2026 at 11:59pm local time.

For more info ⬇️
https://t.co/MjKBH6H41m

El Niño is here. Throughout this fall and winter, San Diego is expecting particularly strong storms, heavy rain, and potential flooding due to El Niño.

Make sure you’re prepared: https://t.co/dG8u8QBZaV

https://t.co/9dSjOH0eoA

This week, I volunteered with Mama’s Kitchen, which provides free meals to San Diegans at risk of malnutrition due to critical illnesses – including several hundred veterans. This work is so important to making sure our community is fed and no one slips through the cracks. https://t.co/fHzjz5OFMf

It was such a pleasure to visit Ms. Castro’s second grade class at Chesterton Elementary School in Linda Vista! About half of the students at this school come from military families, and they had great questions about my job in Congress and our federal government. https://t.co/rqxBa3muye

I joined our local and federal officials to talk about the progress we’ve made to address the Tijuana River Valley crisis. We’re all committed to seeing this crisis through and finally solving it. https://t.co/G7SV9Qa8R1

We need guardrails on AI, NOW. Competition with China is no excuse for letting AI run rampant when people’s life savings are at risk and as I wrote in my op-ed, building AI systems that are actually safe and trustworthy IS our competitive advantage. https://t.co/GdeklD4MhM https://t.co/6RbSet9jxN

It was great to visit and help build one of the tiny homes in El Cajon that’s helped dozens of women and children experiencing homelessness find stability and a path to permanent housing. We need more creative solutions like these to help people get housed. https://t.co/6oz9T6uevA

The average family in CA-51 has paid over $6,500 more for housing, grocery, health care, gas and utilities under President Trump. It’s not a coincidence and it wasn’t inevitable – it’s a result of his (terrible) policy choices.

Read my op-ed to learn about my vision for how Congress should regulate AI – from the frontier model level to how companies and institutions are deploying AI to how it’s impacting workers, students, and economic opportunity.
https://t.co/GdeklD4MhM
It was so fun to answer questions from Dailard Elementary’s 2nd graders! I was asked what my favorite part of my job is and it’s meeting young people like them! https://t.co/h3VMv14By2

Trust and safety are our competitive advantage in the AI race. But to build systems that people actually want to use and trust, Congress needs to act on the societal, model, deployer, and impact levels. Read more in my op-ed:  
https://t.co/GdeklD4MhM

Dropping the “Mother of all Bombs” on Iran will likely fail to achieve meaningful military objectives – and create civilian casualties due to its blast radius. It’s a bad idea by any metric. Trump should end the war, but that won’t happen by dropping more bombs. https://t.co/4MoG4Q2ID1

The Pentagon is trying to avoid accountability, but I won’t let them. I passed an amendment through the House to require the Pentagon to share its report of the Iran school strike with Congress and the public – and I will keep working until it’s law.
https://t.co/UyddYYQCvu

Being first in the AI race won’t matter if no one uses what you build – or if you lose control of the technology. That’s why Congress needs to do its job and act on AI now. Read more in my op-ed here:
https://t.co/GdeklD4MhM

This is every parent’s worst nightmare. I’m devastated for these children, families, faculty and staff, and the Bend community. We need to end the gun violence epidemic before another family endures a preventable tragedy like this.
https://t.co/Jg4OW74sLL

The sailors and Marines on the USS Abraham Lincoln are thankfully home, but our oversight isn’t over. We need answers and accountability to prevent this crisis from happening again – especially for our service members who are still fighting Trump’s war in Iran.

ICE needs to get out of San Diego. They’re terrifying our community and not making anyone any safer.

If you’re stopped or arrested by ICE, know your rights: https://t.co/VCNGb7lFME.
https://t.co/zNmqrbDcNV

Everything about Trump’s war – from its lack of strategy to execution to the hundreds of civilian casualties – makes Iran less likely to adhere to a deal, and undermines U.S. credibility. We need action and accountability about this trend of civilian harm.
https://t.co/4vrWVjMiA3
Donald Trump set a new record today. Americans have NEVER paid over $4 for a gallon of gas nationally this many days in a single year before. #ThanksTrump

Donald Trump is putting a new trade rule in place that will raise the costs of prescription drugs for millions of Americans. The rule could also cause shipping delays or block access to some drugs entirely. If he cared, Trump could stop this immediately.
https://t.co/xBpMEXiabZ

For Stephen Miller and Donald Trump, cruelty has always been the point.

ICE and DHS are continuing to blatantly break the law and Republicans in Congress are nowhere to be found. We need to stop ICE and hold this Administration accountable. 
https://t.co/eFatqGcQm4

Fascists prey on fear, but thankfully, @ilhan is fearless. She won’t back down to anyone when she’s defending Minneapolis or civil rights. It’s why President Trump is weaponizing the federal government to go after her three weeks before an election. I stand with Rep. Omar. https://t.co/kHYCri5xVC

Trump is choosing to make your life more expensive.
https://t.co/5QWkt1TIWo

Trump and Republicans in Congress jacked up the price of health insurance for millions of Americans, including seniors on Medicare. A one time $90 check won’t even cover half of ONE monthly premium bill.
https://t.co/HTOVOVyoFt

Thousands of legal immigrants are about to lose critical health care coverage because of Republicans’ Big Ugly Bill. They pay taxes, contribute to our communities, and have done nothing wrong. Now, many will be forced to turn to emergency rooms instead.
https://t.co/5YUu5Gk77o

San Diego, please make sure you’re prepared for El Niño! We’re expecting heavy rain, storms, and potential flooding this fall and winter — especially this weekend. 

Here are some resources to make sure you and your family are ready. Stay safe! https://t.co/dG8u8QBZaV

Attention San Diego voters: ballots are officially on their way to registered voters, so be sure to keep an eye on your mailbox! For more information about voter registration, tracking your ballot, and how to vote, go to: https://t.co/M1gNwh8DxW https://t.co/jzHZ3ZK9ah
The USS Abraham Lincoln is finally home! https://t.co/8VjfCXORC3

Every day since this tragedy, I’ve worked to end all the suffering, bring real peace and security to Israelis and Palestinians, and stop antisemitism and hatred of all kinds. I still think this is possible and will keep working until it’s a reality.
